mobileEncoding: H.264 High Level 5.1, 24fps, CRF18, 6-frame GOP, faststart. Color and alpha halves independently downsampled with Lanczos; original motion, timing and shadow preserved.
alphaMethod: Local-plate mixed-edge coverage, edge-color recovery, foreground-padded transparent RGB and source-derived shadow. One CRF14 encode; pixel-centered packed RGB/alpha sampling. Visible raster remains 2160x3840 at 24fps.

silence-is-loud.expression: Composed walk, comfortable settled stance, brief picture-right wink and immediate reopening, then quiet natural standing. Finite wink once; only original quiet source12..15 loops. Native1x throughout.

paddock.expression: Warm soft smile during one relaxed planted stance; normal 1x movement. No recurring major support-leg change.

beach.expression: Warm soft smile near, natural free performance. Six-second stance-hold direction was supplied but the source still changes stance more frequently; normal 1x playback.

rockstar.expression: Cool, effortless natural runway presence; neutral identity close-up only. Free gaze and head/shoulder motion, relaxed living near pose; no imposed focused face throughout.

limitations: Down input plays the complete approach at 1x even after scrolling stops. Up requests authored retreat; arbitrary mid-walk turn poses are not separately generated.
Silence plays its arrival wink once, then repeats a living quiet tail; major stance does not reset at the media-loop seam.

Beach natural-rockstar-01 is integrated by explicit user direction for local review. Idle stance changes remain too frequent, and the retreat source clips a sneaker during the initial turn; these source defects are not represented as fixed.
Fast pivots retain source motion blur; this is not a claim of artifact-free footage at arbitrary zoom.
